notes: Deploy the accepted IMD6900RobinhoodLaunch on Robinhood Chain (4663). $owner resolves to the team wallet 0x35da9c0303507ddf708e87f2568eddf12c47a059; the remaining arguments are the existing Uniswap v4 PoolManager, Robinhood IMDSTR and Robinhood timelock, in that order. Preserve the accepted source and compiler settings: solc 0.8.26, via-IR, optimizer 200 runs, Cancun and bytecode_hash none. The constructor creates only IMD6900LockedPool, performs no salt mining and calls no pre-existing contract. After deployment, the team separately calls the permissionless, one-time createHook(salt), using a salt mined off-chain for this launch address by script/launch.sh hook. The resulting IMD6900Hook carries exactly the required permission flags, does not start with 0x91 and is owned by the timelock. Later, the owner separately calls launch() through Programmable's custom launch: it creates the plain, fixed-supply IMD6900 ERC20 at a mined 0x6900-prefixed CREATE2 address, opens the pool with the full 1B supply as coin-only liquidity and performs the opening buy atomically. IMDSTR claims exchange 1:1 within the configured snapshot allowance. The pool has a static 4.44% fee (44_400), no dynamic fee or return deltas, and permanently locked liquidity; anyone can collect fees. Only the timelock can lowerFee, moving the whole position to a lower-fee pool at the same price in one unlock. Default ETH trading-fee proceeds are split 90% to the pot bridge for IMD6900's Ethereum NFT floor pot and 10% to buy $IMD for the canonical Robinhood burn executor 0x4D6537ec564aFf82eABb1Ce5f355E817cBEA1e07. addPerpFees forwards all received ETH to the pot bridge by default. Only the timelock can change the split and destinations via setPayees, setPerpFeeTo, setImdBurn and setImdPool, recover ETH, release excess, sellHeld or endClaims early. This manifest deploys the launch contract alone; the later hook creation and coin launch are separate team operations.
